name: Dungeon Crusaders [ TESTING]
desc:
Embark on a journey to defeat the 🎃 Pumpkin Queen 🎃 and her Pumpkin Minions. [THE HALLOW] is now AVAILABLE for a limited time! Play the Event to win super cool cosmetics to show off to other Crusaders throughout your journey.

Update 3.1.0
Additions & Removals Include:

Addition of Halloween Event [THE HALLOW] 🎃
A new Cast All Button to Use in Dungeons 🔥
14 New Cosmetic Items 🛒
Bug Fixes related to Hover Cards 🐛
Halloween Themed Lobby 🎃
